meta.name: update-arch-docs
meta.description: Audit, prune, and update the project's governance docs — the COLD reference archives `codev/resources/arch.md` and `codev/resources/lessons-learned.md` AND their always-on HOT companions `codev/resources/arch-critical.md` and `codev/resources/lessons-critical.md` (Spec 987, hot/cold two-tier model). Use this skill when running MAINTAIN's arch-doc step, or when asked to update / audit / prune any of those four files. It polices the hot-tier cap (capped facts/lessons + a bounded cold-doc map), enforces displacement (demote to cold when full), keeps each hot file's map accurate, and is opinionated about what NOT to put in each tier (per-spec changelogs, exhaustive enumerations, aspirational state). Two modes: diff-mode (apply a specific change) and audit-mode (propose cuts with reasons). Edits files directly via normal file-edit tooling; no destructive shell commands.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计、精简并更新项目治理文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要维护项目治理文档的冷热双层架构
copy.tagline_en: Audit, prune, and update project governance docs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to maintain a hot/cold two-tier model for project governance docs

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会审计、修剪和更新项目的四个治理文档：冷参考档案 arch.md 和 lessons-learned.md，以及热关键文件 arch-critical.md 和 lessons-critical.md。它会确保热文件容量小（约10条事实 + 12个地图主题）、强制降级多余条目、保持地图准确，并阻止放入不应有的内容（如变更日志、穷举列表、理想状态等）。有两种模式：应用特定变更的 diff 模式，和提出删除建议的 audit 模式。Claude 通过正常文件编辑工具直接修改文件，不使用破坏性 shell 命令。
howto.when: 当运行 MAINTAIN 协议的文档步骤，或当被要求更新、审计或修剪这四个文件中的任何一个时触发。

say.text: 更新 arch.md，添加新的缓存层描述。
对 lessons-learned.md 执行审计，找出需要删除的内容。
修剪 arch-critical.md，将不重要的条目降级到 arch.md。
